title: SQL Quiz : Practice SQL Questions Online - GeeksforGeeks
content:
SQL (Structured Query Language) is used to store, manage and retrieve data in databases. This quiz helps you test and improve your understanding of SQL concepts.

  • Practice SQL queries and database operations.
  • Strengthen problem-solving skills for interviews and real-world tasks.

For a complete guide to SQL, refer to the SQL Tutorial.
